column2: Generated Cargo dependency resolution must remain one canonical workspace lockfile.
Generated npm dependency resolution must remain one canonical package lockfile.
Generated Cargo dependency resolution belongs to the independently built edge proxy workspace.
Fixed upstream benchmark corpus whose line order and identity are part of the dataset.
Generated proof certificate is reviewed and verified as one authenticated artifact; splitting it would change the certificate/verifier contract.
Frozen C runtime is one order-dependent private translation unit; include fragments would only disguise its coupling without creating maintainable module boundaries.
Bootstrap emitter is intentionally one private RAD module; splitting would export internal compiler helpers and change its sealed bootstrap surface.
Bootstrap parser is one stateful routine whose local cursor machinery cannot cross RAD module boundaries without changing semantics.
Bootstrap checker phases share private ECS scope state; a file split would expose internals and alter the frozen cross-backend compiler artifact.
Frozen single-file whole-game parity fixture used unchanged across VM and C-backend conformance runs.
Standalone copy-and-run spell-runtime example is intentionally self-contained as one distributable teaching artifact.
Accepted normative RFC is an immutable review record; fragmenting it would degrade source review and archival links.
